notes: The 178 EUR/year figure is the Parcoursup fiche's general "Frais de scolarité" for this formation (the differentiated non-EU fee of 2902 EUR/year at Licence level is described on the Campus France Maroc page only as an institution-wide rule, not for this programme, and some establishments may exempt); verify the applicable rate with the IUT. The Campus France pages in the set describe the Etudes en France / Campus France procedure and French-certification requirement, not this specific programme. The Parcoursup fiche's "candidat de nationalité étrangère" section confirms such applicants must not register on Parcoursup but use Campus France; a foreign application deadline channel is set separately, so no intake dates are given here.
